verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS scheduling assistant publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an open-source license, a public repository, or source availability. The llms.txt, OpenAPI and MCP probes concern documentation and API access, not source openness, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
